decisions.reason: The Lead Clipper compensation and team-management changes do not alter clip-source rules; the source message's separate one-video constraint is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The Lead Clipper role changes do not alter editing-style requirements; the source message's separate style rules are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Lead Clipper compensation and management responsibilities do not change the standalone teaching-moment requirement, which is independently introduced by another clause of the same message.
The source restates the existing quota of 125 approved clips per month but does not change it; the Lead Clipper role modification has no necessary effect on the quota state.

The source is consistent with the existing three-clip qualification process and does not necessarily change its current attributes; the Lead Clipper role modification applies only after qualification and hire.
Changes to future Lead Clipper compensation and team-management responsibility do not alter the requirement for selecting impactful source moments.
The Lead Clipper role modification neither mentions nor changes caption color or other caption visual-style requirements.
The Lead Clipper role modification does not change the existing 30–90-second clip-duration requirement.
